theses.subject: US Energy Complex
theses.thesis: US Energy is rank 2 with a score of 1.375 and a higher durability_bar (0.62) than the leader, plus the strongest eligible breadth (0.636) in the top tier — the trend-gate leg suggests staying-power rather than return. Unlike the leader, crowding_z is 0.93 (not crowded) with a 'trend' hurst tag; the combination of eligible, durable, broad, and uncrowded makes it the cleanest trend-following lean the detector permits.
evidence: breadth 0.636 — highest among eligible top-tier themes
theses.dissent: Energy leadership at rank 2 could simply be beta to an inflation/geo narrative that is itself unscheduled-heavy (macro_narrative shows geopolitics and inflation in the top themes, unscheduled_share 0.69); if that narrative cools, the theme has no idiosyncratic bid and mean-reverts as fast as it arrived.

theses.subject: AI Infrastructure
theses.thesis: AI Infrastructure is the headline (rank 1, weight 0.25) and is eligible, but its durability_bar is only 0.50 (exactly the headline threshold) and breadth is a thin 0.125 — leadership is concentrated, not broad. The trend gate still marks it eligible, so the permitted lean is a modest overweight, but the weak breadth and sub-0 r10 (-0.0916) argue for sizing this down relative to a high-conviction trend; the detector's own 'mixed' hurst tag confirms this is attention, not a durable established trend.
theses.dissent: With r10 negative and breadth near zero, the theme is a momentum leader in name only; the rank-IC on the clean universe is ~0, so there is no evidence this leadership converts to forward returns at all.

falsifier.text: SMH underperforms the S&P 500 by 3% or more cumulatively over the next 20 trading days

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Cybersecurity is rank 3 and eligible with strong trend signals (durability_bar 0.75, hurst 'trend', breadth 0.6), but crowding_z is 1.61 — the only crowded=true theme among the top tier. Per the guardrails, crowding is a sizing-down caution, never a fade; the disciplined expression of that caution is an underweight lean, which the trend gate's stay-in-power logic also weakly supports as a de-risk.
theses.dissent: Crowding flags have no basket-level forward edge — they only mark constituent-level fragility; an underweight could mean missing continued trend continuation in a still-eligible, durable, broad theme.

falsifier.text: CIBR outperforms the S&P 500 by 5% or more cumulatively before the 30-day check date
